sentences.en: The whale is well known to be the largest mammal.
sentences.zh: 鲸鱼是众所周知的最大哺乳动物。

sentences.en: A whale is no less a mammal than a horse.
sentences.zh: 鲸鱼和马一样都是哺乳动物。

sentences.en: Whales are very large mammals that live in the ocean.
sentences.zh: 鲸鱼是非常大的海洋哺乳动物。

senses.zh: 哺乳动物 形容词: mammalian

mnemonic: 词根记忆：mamm（乳房）+al（表物）→哺乳动物
